oneLine: Burma Burma operator files IPO papers for a fresh issue to fund expansion.
seller: Ankit Virendra Gupta, Chirag Narendra Chhajer, Bbigplas Poly Pvt Ltd, Negen Tech Opportunities Angel Fund +others

sources.title: Burma Burma Operator Files IPO Papers, Plans ₹150 Crore Fresh Issue To Expand Restaurant Network

synopsis: Hunger Pangs Ltd, the operator of Burma Burma Restaurant & Tea Room, has filed draft IPO papers with SEBI for a public issue consisting of a fresh equity issue of up to ₹150 crore and an offer for sale of up to 2.79 crore shares. Promoters Ankit Virendra Gupta and Chirag Narendra Chhajer, promoter group company Bbigplas Poly Pvt Ltd, Negen Tech Opportunities Angel Fund, Venture Catalysts Angel Growth Fund, and L V Angel Fund are participating as selling shareholders in the offer for sale. The fresh issue proceeds will be used to fund the opening of new Burma Burma restaurants and for general corporate purposes. Panthomath Capital Advisors is acting as the sole book-running lead manager for the offering.
